arms.classificationReason: One finite exposure with3maintenancecycles; replies outstanding atwindow end and trailing maintenance/drain do not prove unbounded500/s queue growth or sustained capacity. Equivalent-cut backlog drift over a separately registered longer exposure is still needed; no capacity promotion from one pair.

config.maintenanceDispatchPolicy: drain pending while arrivals keep enqueuing/rejecting; exactprefix force/readback thenACK
config.physicalAdmissionTimestampSemantics: monotonic return observation after the first nonnegative publication.offer; not an exact internal Aeron admission instant
config.readCreditPolicy: reserve+flush before arm; completed-unconsumed holds credit; consume after reply/timing flush
config.scope: Finite openloop source; external canonical/leader/config proof required before any stability or capacity claim

egressAssociationAttestation.scope: Source-enforced per-callback actual Header/Image validation with independently reconciled aggregate counts/geometry. Raw reply tape has no Image ID; no independent per-reply Image mapping claimed.

arms.readOwnerCapacityScope: Source-enforced bound and runtime high-water; exact retained/consume intervals cannot be independently reconstructed from timing CSV.

readPhaseBindings.timingScope: Phase min reservation start through max coordinator end is an observed lower bound, not exact bank lifetime. Per RPC coordinator end is after logical reply flush, before timing flush/consume. Elapsed includes ordered head wait and overlapping read intervals; retained capacity is source-enforced/runtime-attested, without independent consume timestamps.

limitations: One arm is a finite observation. Four ordered same-artifact idle arms each require preceding independent collection gates. No automatic promotion.
Finite same-host three-JVM source, no sustained maximum, independent-host network/storage durability, zero-latency or 100M claim.
Last reply and final maintenance boundary drains are recomputed; totalSourceDrainNs is reported and ordered, without separately logged terminal event.
Read RPC elapsed includes ordered head wait, transport, server, scheduling and evidence writes. Intervals overlap; their sum is not wall time or pure fsync.

Actual per-callback Header/Image association is source enforced and aggregate counters close against raw reply totals; raw reply tape contains NO Image ID, so independent per-reply Image mapping is not claimed.
Telemetry is bounded/sampled; Java/Python monotonic alignment is not validated and UTC phase labels are coarse.
scope: Independent LOCAL strict successful-round raw audit. No SSH, Git, process launch or mutation of raw inputs. Nonzero/partial outcomes retain an all-arrival inventory and fail strict closure rather than being hidden.

telemetry.phaseMethod: Coarse UTC labels only, Java origin Instant is approximate and Python UTC sampling is not atomic. CPU deltas use only Python monotonic times on identical PID/startTicks/argv SHA.
telemetry.scope: 1 Hz sampled owned process CPU/RSS/kernel IO; observed spans include startup/load/maintenance/shutdown. Missing/exited counters are explicit; no zeros invented. No pure force/fsync latency or independent storage saturation inference.
